test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c91d6f066e4e5d1fde4c73ef0a17fd60a1f3ec0ddd3905589bc309254debae83.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: TXT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30c17622d25cc56e85f73a4856ff78cc1799e97a0de5ddf9b7326fcbee647a9f.png] 

Option 2: HLG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd4f111e0d63a08e8b8509b062fad5d43cc7b78d861ad7825c79ebc134cba921.png] 

Option 3: KOJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4cb93d58da29b766d766726cc0c7373ab44577b647e35ba46ebd374c72bbffa.png] 

Option 4: EID

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7715ea265684828bf38a8c1931cbcb318d3e721b7d2005fa2659556b4df818fc.png] 

Thus, TXT does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
